john.12.p1.b1.text: Six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, the hometown of Lazarus, whom He had raised from the dead.

john.12.p1.b2.text: So they hosted a dinner for Jesus there. Martha served,

john.12.p1.b3.text: And Lazarus was among those reclining at the table with Him.

john.12.p2.b1.text: Then Mary took about a pint of expensive perfume, made of pure nard, and she anointed Jesus’ feet

john.12.p2.b2.text: And wiped them with her hair.

john.12.p2.b3.text: And the house was filled with the fragrance of the perfume.

john.12.p3.b1.text: But one of His disciples, Judas Iscariot, who was going to betray Him, asked,

john.12.p3.b2.text: Why wasn’t this perfume sold for three hundred denarii and the money given to the poor?

john.12.p3.b3.text: Judas did not say this because he cared about the poor, but because he was a thief. As keeper of the money bag, he used to take from what was put into it.

john.12.p4.b1.text: Leave her alone, … She has kept this perfume in preparation for the day of My burial.

john.12.p4.b2.text: The poor you will always have with you,

john.12.p4.b3.text: But you will not always have Me.

john.12.p5.b1.text: Meanwhile a large crowd of Jews learned that Jesus was there. And they came … also to see Lazarus, whom He had raised from the dead.

john.12.p5.b2.text: So the chief priests made plans to kill Lazarus as well,

john.12.p5.b3.text: for on account of him many of the Jews were deserting them and believing in Jesus.

john.12.p6.b1.text: The next day the great crowd that had come to the feast heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem.

john.12.p6.b2.text: They took palm branches and went out to meet Him, shouting:

john.12.p6.b4.text: Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord! Blessed is the King of Israel!

john.12.p7.b1.text: Finding a young donkey, Jesus sat on it,

john.12.p7.b2.text: “Do not be afraid, O Daughter of Zion. See, your King is coming, seated on the colt of a donkey.”

john.12.p7.b3.text: At first His disciples did not understand these things, but after Jesus was glorified they remembered … that these very things had also been written about Him.

john.12.p8.b1.text: Meanwhile, many people continued to testify that they had been with Jesus when He called Lazarus from the tomb and raised him from the dead.

john.12.p8.b2.text: That is also why the crowd went out to meet Him, because they heard that He had performed this sign.

john.12.p8.b3.text: You can see that this is doing you no good.

john.12.p8.b4.text: Look how the whole world has gone after Him!

john.12.p9.b1.text: Now there were some Greeks among those who went up to worship at the feast.

john.12.p9.b2.text: Sir, we want to see Jesus.

john.12.p9.b3.text: Philip relayed this appeal to Andrew, and both of them went and told Jesus.

john.12.p10.b1.text: The hour has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.

john.12.p10.b3.text: Unless a kernel of wheat falls to the ground and dies, it remains only a seed;

john.12.p10.b4.text: But if it dies, it bears much fruit.

john.12.p11.b1.text: Whoever loves his life will lose it, but whoever hates his life in this world will keep it for eternal life.

john.12.p11.b2.text: If anyone serves Me, he must follow Me; and where I am, My servant will be as well.

john.12.p11.b3.text: If anyone serves Me, the Father will honor him.

john.12.p12.b1.text: Now My soul is troubled, and what shall I say?

john.12.p12.b2.text: Father, save Me from this hour? No, it is for this purpose that I have come to this hour.

john.12.p12.b4.text: I have glorified it, and I will glorify it again.

john.12.p13.b2.text: An angel had spoken to Him.

john.12.p13.b3.text: This voice was not for My benefit, but yours.

john.12.p13.b4.text: Now judgment is upon this world; now the prince of this world will be cast out.

john.12.p13.b5.text: And I, when I am lifted up from the earth, will draw everyone to Myself.”

john.12.p13.b6.text: He said this to indicate the kind of death He was going to die.

john.12.p14.b1.text: … the Christ will remain forever. So how can you say that the Son of Man must be lifted up? Who is this Son of Man?

john.12.p14.b2.text: For a little while longer, the Light will be among you. Walk while you have the Light, so that darkness will not overtake you.

john.12.p14.b3.text: While you have the Light, believe in the Light, so that you may become sons of light.

john.12.p14.b4.text: After Jesus had spoken these things, He went away and was hidden from them.

john.12.p15.b1.text: Although Jesus had performed so many signs in their presence, they still did not believe in Him.

john.12.p15.b2.text: Lord, who has believed our message? And to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?

john.12.p15.b3.text: “He has blinded their eyes and hardened their hearts, so that they cannot see with their eyes, and understand with their hearts, and turn, and I would heal them.”

john.12.p16.b1.text: Nevertheless, many of the leaders believed in Him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess Him, for fear that they would be put out of the synagogue.

john.12.p16.b2.text: For they loved praise from men more than praise from God.

john.12.p16.b3.text: Whoever believes in Me does not believe in Me alone, but in the One who sent Me. And whoever sees Me sees the One who sent Me.

john.12.p16.b4.text: I have come into the world as a light, so that no one who believes in Me should remain in darkness.

john.12.p17.b1.text: As for anyone who hears My words and does not keep them, I do not judge him. For I have not come to judge the world, but to save the world.

john.12.p17.b2.text: There is a judge for the one who rejects Me and does not receive My words: The word that I have spoken will judge him on the last day.

john.12.p17.b3.text: … the Father who sent Me has commanded Me what to say and how to say it.

john.12.p17.b4.text: And I know that His command leads to eternal life.
